'''Edan News Today''' was a [[vidchannel]] news program on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a presence on the world, Edan News Today screened programming on the benefits of Imperial occupation.
